name: Switch
description:
On or off, applied immediately. The track takes the accent when on and the glass thumb
travels on the spring curve. Use a Checkbox instead when the choice only applies after
a Save.
signature: ({ label, description, className, disabled, id, ...rest }: SwitchProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: description
props.description: Second line: what turning it on does.

props.name: icons
props.description: ✓ / ✕ inside the bead (md and lg).

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid outside a Field.

props.name: label
props.description: Label beside the switch. Omit when a Field (or an aria-label) names it.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: tone
props.description: The "on" colour. Status tones only when the setting itself is a status (R3.3).

props.name: checked
props.description:
Whether the switch is currently active.

To render an uncontrolled switch, use the `defaultChecked` prop instead.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description:
Whether the switch is initially active.

To render a controlled switch, use the `checked` prop instead.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: form
props.description:
Identifies the form that owns the hidden input.
Useful when the switch is rendered outside the form.

props.name: id
props.description:
The id of the hidden input element.

When `nativeButton` is `true`, the id is applied to the root element.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden `<input>` element.

props.name: name
props.description: Identifies the field when a form is submitted.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Event handler called when the switch is activated or deactivated.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to activate or deactivate the switch.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must activate the switch before submitting a form.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: uncheckedValue
props.description:
The value submitted with the form when the switch is off.
By default, unchecked switches do not submit any value, matching native checkbox behavior.

props.name: value
props.description:
The value submitted with the form when the switch is on.
By default, switch submits the "on" value, matching native checkbox behavior.
